geometryInspection.selectedRegions: Trochlear upper band visually inspected on actual talar triangles; source muscle distal tip at medial cuneiform/first metatarsal area. Masks are authored source-vertex constraints, not verified microscopic attachment footprints. Native left resources and instance matrices used; all source vertex/triangle correspondences verified before reusing inspected regions.
geometryInspection.maskConstruction: Source-local positions transformed by exact instance matrix. Authored lower/upper blending planes 0.045/0.160m in atlas Y, fixed >=0.160m, co-moving <=0.045m; proximal and distal vertex lists explicitly retained. Not inferred anatomical origin/insertions.
geometryInspection.contactConstraint: Triangle winding contact constraints preserve original overlap/contact; corrective pins are engineering constraints, not anatomical origin/insertion labels. Four sampled morph states track rigid bone arcs.

unresolved: Exact ankle axis and subtalar coupling are unmeasured; this is a 6.5 degree educational sagittal approximation.
Microscopic OI footprints, retinacular sliding, independent toe-joint degrees of freedom and physiological contraction/bulging are not modeled.
Passive surfaces use source-vertex boundary constraints; individual activation/co-contraction is not claimed. Source-provided neutral/bind pose remains unavailable.
